name: Omni PGA Frisco Resort
insider_take: This championship resort isn't just about luxury—it's the epicenter of professional golf's future, where PGA of America headquarters meets Texas hospitality.
whats_special: Home to the first-ever PGA of America headquarters outside Florida, featuring two championship golf courses designed by Gil Hanse and Beau Welling. The resort sits on 660 acres and will host major PGA tournaments, including the 2027 PGA Championship.
pro_tip: Book tee times early morning or late afternoon for cooler Texas temperatures and stunning golden hour lighting across the prairie landscape.
dont_miss: The PGA District's entertainment complex with top-tier dining and nightlife, plus easy access to The Star (Dallas Cowboys headquarters) and vibrant Legacy West shopping district—all within 10 minutes of the resort.
pros: World-class championship golf courses designed by Gil Hanse
Modern luxury resort with exceptional spa and wellness facilities
Multiple dining venues including upscale restaurants and casual options
State-of-the-art event spaces and meeting facilities
cons: Located in suburban Frisco, requiring transportation to Dallas attractions
